title: Subscription Billing: respect Default Dimension Priorities on Subscription Lines
summary: Subscription Billing now respects Default Dimension Priorities when creating subscription lines from contracts, ensuring Item dimensions override Customer dimensions when configured with higher priority, instead of always letting Customer values win.
key_points: SetDefaultDimensions now passes the correct source code (Sales/Purchases) to enable Default Dimension Priority lookup
Customer/Vendor is added as a dimension source alongside Item/GL Account for proper priority evaluation
GetRecDefaultDimID is used with inherited dimension set from contracts, matching the standard SalesLine.CreateDim pattern
UpdateFromCustomerContract/VendorContract now route through SetDefaultDimensions instead of blind-merging
Billing-time merge behavior remains unchanged to preserve subscription line dimension authority
